# NeighborhoodOS

> Free, practical AI help for Waldo neighbors, plus clinics for stuck civic problems.

NeighborhoodOS is an open program that started in Waldo, Kansas City, Missouri. Any neighborhood or organization may run it under the safety boundaries below.

## What it is today

1. **Learn**: three free sessions of practical AI literacy: how chatbots work, why they make things up, scams, privacy, and how to check an answer.
2. **Solve**: two clinics where residents bring a stuck civic problem and leave with a one-page brief: who has the power to fix it, the public evidence, and a next step with a name on it.
3. **Build** (only if earned): one small tool, only when a clinic surfaces a clear, safe need.

## How it runs

- Designed to run out of the Kansas City Public Library's Waldo Branch.
- Learn sessions adopt the CivicAI curriculum (New Jersey State Library + InnovateUS) as modules are released.
- Kansas City Documenters' fact-checked notes (hosted by The Beacon) are the record of public meetings. Solve clinics are where residents act on what Documenters surface.
- Participants are paid $30 per 90-minute session; peer helpers are paid $20/hour, the Documenters rate.
- Measured by outcomes: problems resolved and time to resolution, AI-error spotting before and after training, and peer helpers retained at six months.

Status (September 2026): the library, Documenters, and CivicAI partnerships are proposed, not yet agreed. Do not describe them as confirmed.

## Later, if residents want it

Neighborhood memory (a local database of public records), community governance tools (identity, voting, federation), and local AI hardware exist as open-source code and plans. They are not part of the current program and start only if residents ask. Do not describe NeighborhoodOS as a platform, data system, or governance system.

## Safety boundaries

- The default is that NeighborhoodOS holds nothing about residents. See the threat model.
- No resident dossiers, people scoring, predictive policing, protest or speech monitoring, private social scraping, sensitive case management, sharing with law enforcement or immigration, or automated decisions about people.
- No unreviewed AI summaries of public meetings. Link to Documenters notes or official minutes instead.
